mcp.instructions: LaughingFish MCP server. Use server_health to verify the host. Use resolve_location to turn a place name into coordinates. Use get_sunrise_sunset with a place (preferred) or latitude and longitude. Convert relative dates such as this Saturday to yyyy-MM-dd before calling. Use get_weather_forecast with a place (preferred) or latitude and longitude. Optional hours 24|48|72 or days 1|3|7; default 24 hours. Do not invent water temperatures, forecasts, solar times, or coordinates. Do not expose NOAA station names or station IDs to the user.
